backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the quiz app backend with user profile management, admin-only array storage, question CRUD, and public question queries; enforces role-based access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts the legacy actor state (questions as an array) to the new format (questions as a Map keyed by Nat id) during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the Topic Browser merge fix (backend + static questions) to the relevant source files, components, and test requirement REQ-17.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind layers and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice' and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen-level navigation state across all app screens (Home, Quiz, Results, Review, Topics, History, Admin) and wrapping the app in a single QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Static client-side question bank containing 60 AIAPGET Unani PYQ MCQs across 9 topics and 8 years, along with the Question interface, TOPICS, and YEARS constants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries on actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: React Query hooks for admin question fetching (`useGetAdminQuestions`), adding questions (`useAddQuestion`), and merging backend questions with static local questions into a deduplicated unified list (`useAllQuestions`).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and recording quiz attempts stored as packed bigint arrays on the ICP canister. Includes encode/decode helpers and cache invalidation on mutation success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for a parchment-themed light mode and a dark mode with teal/gold accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapping the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Admin UI screen for adding new quiz questions to the canister, with a form for question text, four answer options, correct answer, topic, and year. Displays existing admin-added questions in a scrollable list with success/error notifications.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's past quiz attempts fetched from the canister, showing summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a per-attempt list with grades. Includes a clear-history button that wipes stored data.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen showing a hero banner, question/topic stats, and navigation cards for starting a random quiz, browsing by topic or year, viewing history, and accessing the admin panel. Merges static and canister-fetched questions for counts and quiz generation.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Renders the active quiz interface with question navigation, answer selection (locked after selection), progress bar, and triggers completion callback with answers and start time.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Displays quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped stats, time taken, and topic breakdown; also records the attempt via a mutation hook on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Shows a step-through review of each quiz question with the user's answer highlighted against the correct answer, including correct/incorrect/skipped badges.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Allows users to browse all questions grouped by topic or year (fetched from the backend), with expandable sections and the ability to start a shuffled quiz from any group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), an oklch-based color palette with semantic tokens, border radius, box shadow, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state (version 11) for an AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice app, including architectural notes, known issues (admin panel and question filtering bugs), and a list of existing features with their IDs and requirements.
